BiblicalUsage: Shage is named once, as the father of Jonathan the Hararite, one of David's mighty men. His son stands in the list of warriors who gathered to David, and the father's name is all Scripture gives us.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a single mention can still place a man among the mighty, because God counts the fathers of His warriors too.
